results.name: Chronicle your adventures
results.description: What do you describe within logs, journals, or maps? What adventure still calls to you?

results.name: Commune with nature
results.description: What flora or fauna do you encounter? What inspiration do you draw from the experience?

results.name: Concoct a plan
results.description: What new strategy do you devise? How will you put this plan in motion?

results.name: Conduct research
results.description: What is the nature of the research? What information or insight do you gain?

results.name: Conduct training
results.description: What skills or knowledge do you share? Who accepts the guidance, and who resists it?

results.name: Confess a secret
results.description: What do you reveal of your nature or background? How do others respond?

results.name: Conjure up the past
results.description: What is the subject of this reminiscence? Why is it meaningful in this moment?

results.name: Create an object or artwork
results.description: What do you create? What is it intended for?

results.name: Experience a dream or vision
results.description: What is the nature of the dream or vision? What meaning do you draw from it?

results.name: Fight in a sparring match
results.description: Who do you spar with? What issues do you provoke or resolve during the match?

results.name: Find peace
results.description: How do you reflect, meditate, or pray? What enlightenment do you gain?

results.name: Hear a confession
results.description: Who shares an aspect of their nature or background? What do they reveal?

results.name: Indulge a vice
results.description: What weakness or need do you indulge? How is this viewed by others?

results.name: Join an event
results.description: What is the occasion of this social gathering? How do you participate?

results.name: Lead or join a song
results.description: What is the subject of this song? Why is it meaningful to you or others?

results.name: Motivate others
results.description: Why is this motivation needed, and what is your approach? How do they respond?

results.name: Play a game
results.description: Who do you play with? What is discussed during the game?

results.name: Practice a skill
results.description: What talent do you hone? What do you learn from the exercise?

results.name: Ready your gear
results.description: How do you maintain your equipment or gear up? What are you preparing for?

results.name: Record a message
results.description: Who is the message meant for? What news or feelings do you share?

results.name: Reinvent your look
results.description: What inspires you to remake yourself? How do you debut your new look?

results.name: Settle a conflict
results.description: What caused this argument or fight? How do you resolve the situation?

results.name: Share intimacy
results.description: Who do you spend time with? How does your relationship evolve?

results.name: Share your heritage
results.description: What do you offer of your family's or people's history? What memory or regret does it evoke?

results.name: Stay vigilant
results.description: What are you on the lookout for? What do you spot or overhear?

results.name: Stir up trouble
results.description: What conflict do you incite or inflame? Why is the situation left unresolved?

results.name: Take in the view
results.description: What sublime or dramatic scenery do you witness? What emotion or memory does it inspire?

results.name: Tell a tale
results.description: What is the nature of this myth or legend? What emotion or lesson lingers after the telling?

results.name: Undertake a communal labor
results.description: What demanding project do you embark on with others? How does this bring you closer together?

results.name: Undertake a menial task
results.description: What solitary chore do you perform? What do you daydream about as you work?
